schema: # Declared bootstrap network use of an install (Sub-plan 4; PRIV-BOOTSTRAP-DECLARED,
# WF-DNS-003). Parsed as data by the installer tests; never sourced. An install
# makes no other network call, and none of these ever becomes a client DNS path:
# host DNS is never rewritten for them. (On a Mullvad host whose loopback-only
# custom DNS answers nothing and no nice-dns stack runs, the Linux install
# switches Mullvad to its default DNS before these run; lib/install.sh,
#   call      an ERE matching the call as the installer makes it
#   phase     preparation: before anything is interrupted (host DNS still the
#             owner's or the running stack's pin, or Mullvad's default DNS
#             interruption: after the stack stopped; host DNS then stays pinned
#             to the stopped stack, so the call must need no host resolver
#   resolver  host: the host's resolver as it is in that phase
#             own: the tool's own bootstrap resolver
#             builder: the builder's own resolver, from the macOS build
#   A public resolver written into the product (checked by
#   path      the file, from the checkout root
#   line      an ERE, anchored at both ends, matching the whole line
#   phase     also runtime: every start after the install (boot, restart),
#             host DNS pinned to the stack
#   A comment that mentions the resolver names its row ("literal <id>"), or a
#   row declares that comment line itself (a file nice-dns does not author).
